from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyLiability(BaseModel):
    """Financial liability data extracted from one company's filing."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name as written in the filing")
    liability_type: str | None = Field(description="The specific liability line item as written (e.g., 'Total Current Liabilities', 'Total Liabilities')")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The raw liability amount as a float; sign and magnitude as reported")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="How the amount is expressed: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period or date the liability is as of")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim line containing the liability label and amount")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_liabilities: list[CompanyLiability]
